# Roman Bandurin — Projects Catalog

> Catalog of projects published on GitHub Pages by Roman Bandurin. Each project is
> published from its own repository under its own path; this root site is the directory.

## Projects

- [Crypto — Web Crypto API Playground & Agentic Tool Server](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/): browser-based
  cryptography playground (digests, encryption, signatures, key generation) with an AI
  chat and WebMCP tool server. Fully client-side, no backend.
  - Documentation: [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/llms.txt](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/llms.txt),
    [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/llms-full.txt](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/llms-full.txt),
    [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/AGENTS.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/AGENTS.md),
    [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/index.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/index.md),
    [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/openapi.json](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/crypto/openapi.json)

## Site

- [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/llms-full.txt](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/llms-full.txt): full documentation of this catalog
- [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/AGENTS.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/AGENTS.md): instructions for agents
- [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/index.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/index.md): markdown mirror of this page
- [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/glossary.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/glossary.md): glossary of discovery, protocol and cryptographic terms
- [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/openapi.json](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/openapi.json): machine-readable catalog contract
- [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/sitemap.md](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/sitemap.md): structured map of agent-readable surfaces
- [https://roman-bandurin.github.io/sitemap.xml](https://roman-bandurin.github.io/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap
